title: Our class recycling week
text:
Report: Our Class Recycling Week
By Class 3B

Last week, our class counted all the rubbish we threw away. We wanted to find out how much we could recycle.

What we did
First, we put three boxes in the classroom. One box was for paper, one was for plastic bottles and one was for food waste. Every day, we weighed what went into each box.

What we found
By Friday, we had collected 6 kilograms of paper, 2 kilograms of plastic bottles and 4 kilograms of food waste. The paper box was the heaviest. Most of the paper was from worksheets that were only used on one side.

What we will do next
We will use both sides of the paper from now on. The plastic bottles will go to the recycling bank near the market. We will put the food waste in a compost bin in the school garden.

Conclusion
Small changes can make a big difference. If every class does the same, our school will throw away much less rubbish.
